title.en: MALACAÑAN PALACE BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES EXTENDING THE SUSPENSION OF IMPORTATION OF REGULAR MILLED AND WELL-MILLED RICE UNTIL 31 DECEMBER 2025

text.en:
Extension of Suspension of Importation of Regular Milled and
Well-Milled Rice. Pursuant to the recommendation of the DA, the importation of regular
milled and well-milled rice shall remain suspended until 31 December 2025.
The suspension of importation shall not cover specialty rice varieties not
commonly produced by local farmers.

Period of Suspension. The period of suspension of importation of
regular milled and well-milled rice may be shortened or extended, as may be necessary,
upon the joint recommendation of the DA, DEPDev, and DTI.
For this purpose, the DA, DEPDev, and DTI shall convene within 30 days upon
effectivity of this Order to evaluate the effects of the suspension of importation on the
supply and prices of rice in the country, and within 15 days therefrom submit a joint
recommendation to the President, through the Executive Secretary.

Directives under EO No. 93. The directives under Sections 3, 4, and
5 of EO No. 93 are hereby adopted.

Separability. If any part or provision of this Order is held invalid or
unconstitutional, the provisions not affected thereby shall remain in full force and effect.

Repeal. All orders, rules and regulations, and other issuances or parts
thereot, which are inconsistent with the provisions of this Order, are hereby repealed or
modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately upon publication
in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 30th day of October
year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-Five.
By the President:
CASS. BERSAMIN
Exeeutive Secretary
